Delivery policy
policies.content: Isolation delivers across Bangladesh. Delivery charges depend on the delivery zone (inside Dhaka, Dhaka suburbs, outside Dhaka) and are listed in the delivery settings. Estimated delivery times are only stated when configured by the team.
